findings.what: onOpen navigation formula deviates from spec
findings.why: The spec (section 6, line 164) explicitly states the formula: `history.push(\`${match.url}/ai\`)`. The implementation uses `history.push(\`${match.url.replace(/\/[^\/]+$/, "")}/ai\`)`, which strips the last path segment before appending `/ai`. The deviation is functionally motivated: `match` in JobApplicationActivity is the renderProps match for the `/overview` route (match.url = `.../overview`), so the spec formula would produce `.../overview/ai` which has no matching route. The implementation strips `/overview` to get `.../ai` which is correct. However, this is a spec-implementation mismatch. The spec's stated formula is wrong for the actual match.url value that arrives in this component, but the spec did not intend the renderProps match — it appears the spec assumed `match.url` would be the container-level URL (`.../candidates/456`), not the sub-route URL (`.../candidates/456/overview`). Per the spec-implementation mismatch rule, the deviation must be surfaced for Jessica to decide: either accept the implementation's regex as the correct fix, or align the spec.
